learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to work with freely available game systems and will be able to create a game and other visualization applications using these systems. Primarily, they will be able to work with the Unreal Engine environment.

syllabus_topics: Visual programming using Blueprints (functions, macros, structures, classes) and their connection with the scene
Control of characters by the player - movement, jumping, flying, swimming, falling
Perception and reaction to events in the environment
Network games and connection with external programs
assessment_rules: The final assessment is based on project implementation. The indicative evaluation scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The assessment scale is 100/0 for preliminary/final.
bibliography: 3D game engine design : A practical approach to Real-Time computer graphics / David H. Eberly. Amsterdam: Elsevier, 2007
Real-time rendering / Tomas Akenine - Möller , Eric Haines, Naty Hoffman. Wellesley : AK Peters, 2008
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
